title: Build: multi-year ETF/equity 1h+5m history pipeline (Alpaca/IB/open sources) into the trainer canonical store, with freshness check + daily refresh
note: Operator 2026-11-01: 'no way we are limited to 2 years of etf data'. Yahoo 1h caps ~730d; pipeline gap, not a data limit. Lane ETF-HISTORY-PIPELINE (Manager Session 2026-11-01a), ceiling 30 USD, due_by 2026-11-01. Supersedes the data-gap half of TF-EQUITY-INTRADAY-BARS. Scope: measured source inventory, runner/trainer pipeline, freshness check + daily incremental, depth read-back, notify ML-FEATURE-INFRA / ALPACA-LIVE-ACTIVITY-ML / RESEARCH-EDGE. [2026-11-01 lane] BUILT, NOT RUN: PR #22136 (held, Tier-2 workflow). No keys in a lane sandbox so NO depth table exists yet. CLOSES WHEN: after merge, label etf-history-request body 'mode: probe' (measures Alpaca SIP/IEX depth per timeframe + Yahoo/Stooq keyless), then 'mode: backfill', then 'mode: verify' shows >=8y 1h and per-symbol 5m first/last/rows/gaps for the ~31-symbol universe; the 3 ML/research lanes are then told the read path (trainer data/etf_history/<SYM>/<tf>.parquet via fetch_etf_history.read_bars). NOT DONE: IB historical path (documented, unmeasured; needs gateway via live VM) -- cross-check source only, MES/MGC/MHG futures are not Alpaca-covered. [2026-11-01 lane, later] WIDENED to config/data_universe.yaml (1,019 equity symbols = 274 ETFs + 503 current + 242 removed S&P 500 names; 55 option underlyings); store is per-year parquet; quarterly sp500-membership-refresh.yml; publish-to-HF-lake step inert until repo variable MARKET_LAKE_HF_REPO is set (coordinating with lane MARKET-DATA-LAKE). Trainer disk is a CACHE; disk preflight stays as the cache guard. [2026-11-01 lane, 1m base] Operator rule (relayed by MARKET-DATA-LAKE): keep the smallest timeframe. Store is now the 1m BASE in monthly partitions; 5m/1h derived on read (resample_bars). MEASURED trainer disk (diag #22140): 97 GB, 53 used, 45 GB free, pandas 3.0.3, pyarrow 24.0.0, 1 CPU, 5.9 GB RAM. 1m projection ~14 GB (10-25) for ~770 symbols with data, ~55k Alpaca requests (~6 h at 150/min = ~3-4 resumable runs): PROJECTION, not measured on real data. Workflow stops <15 GB to start / <10 GB mid-run with numbers. Derived-vs-native cross-check filed (due 11-04). [2026-11-01 lane, store of record] Per manager/operator design mandate the HF lake (bentzbk/jta-market-lake) is the STORE OF RECORD for the 1m base; trainer is a TAIL CACHE (current+previous month). Workflow hands each finished chunk to MARKET-DATA-LAKE's publisher (free_sources.py import-etf + hf_publish.py upload), guarded: if scripts/data_lake or HF_TOKEN is absent, or a publish fails, that chunk goes to the trainer IN FULL so no history is dropped. Trainer pruning of old months deliberately NOT automated until the lake copy is confirmed.
